description:
ERP butterfly figure from epoched data: one subplot per class, all
channel means (thin) + across-channel mean (bold), time-locked to the
trial event. Shows whether class-conditioned evoked structure exists
BEFORE training anything.

max_channels.description: Channels drawn per class subplot (default 16, max 64).

mode.description: Pack split to load: training | evaluation | all (source=dataset).

path.description: Upload path (source=upload) or absolute local path (source=local).

save.description: Also write the PNG to NIMBUS_EXPORT_DIR/plots/ and return its path.

source.description:
"dataset" (MOABB pack), "upload" (path from data.upload), or
"local" (absolute path, local backend only).

name: plots.erp
title: Plots.Erp
